Product Launch Checklist for Marketing Sites

A deploy-ready list that keeps your Eleventy marketing site polished for launch day.

Launches are stressful, but checklists reduce the chaos. I outline the steps my team follows: confirm redirects, double-check metadata, verify analytics, and rehearse incident response scenarios. The article includes a printable PDF and a Notion template you can duplicate for your own launches.
